comprehensive_coverage.rationale: variant_registry lists 20 combos, but the 5 illustrative samples don't include a single case of true multi-digit regrouping multiplication (e.g. 47×6), so the specific regrouping requirement central to this competency is unconfirmed.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The trivial ×0 facts shown are well below the cognitive demand grade-3-Q3 multi-digit multiplication with regrouping should require.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The variant space as illustrated shows the 'leading digit only non-zero' multiple-of-10 case only once and no regrouping case at all, so the registered combos cannot be confirmed to cover this competency's stated scope.

competency_alignment.rationale: The ×0/×1 identity facts are more appropriate to q3_0/q3_1's table-fluency and properties content than to this node's regrouping-multiplication competency.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Products observed top out at 110, far short of the 'products up to 10 000' ceiling this competency states.
